notes: Card: ' <' x6, '-D', '>', '|', '...', '(..' in comments/docstrings. Probes: marked-up comments 0.20-0.47 ('[batch_size' 0.43, 'ParseConfig(..)' 0.47, ' <' 0.38), the same comments without markup 0.02-0.07, a real '<' comparison 0.04. Amplitudes are modest, so the median is the risk.
